items.note: S4.1 states the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires; the sub-steps follow the proof: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the bit and complex central coefficients cancelled by the side wires, the three stages (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x), and the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c.

The invariant (stored array = D_v applied to the logical array), its passage through edges and through a pointwise gate by commuting with the common frame, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} all match the paper.

It covers the bilinear spaces, terminal labels, stage transitions, the gate-label table, nesting on the side edge 2->5, the single decrease on center 3->4 (loss h, L=Ich), telescoping to Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal residual bases over F_2, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The per-edge residual table is not reproduced but is implied by the gate labels. The S4.3 headline wording ('L/N = 100/539 ... below N/2') is sloppy, but S4.3.5 states it correctly.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks with -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, the endpoint check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m all match the proof.

It follows the proof step by step: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, the phase difference as a sum over the residual basis, the character-to-translation identity giving aI+bX_v, the X_a->Y_a pair fixed with C=iZC^{-1}Z and i^{27k}, then negation and unexchange to give C^{tensor m}. It also states s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m.

L<N/2, both strict inequalities s<Wm, the exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 above 20*2^-50, log m<20, and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 all match lines 1319-1346.

S2 and S3 state both lemmas with their content: digit permutation, digit move, split/merge, cyclic row split into W streams, and the controlled shift y+a(controls) mod Q at O(V) with unit multiplication. S3 gives the split-and-merge idea in one phrase but has no sub-steps, so it counts as stated. The b^{O(1)} offset condition appears only in S3's quote.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2, the elimination (topmost row, rightmost pivot), the choice of an odd prime avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators, triangular transforms as O(V) controlled shifts, and the three-update one-interchange implementation of H_i<-H_i+D_j all follow the proof.

Cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, the Phi_{A_e} edge shears done by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum cases, and the fixed-tape parking/descriptor schedule all match.

The k and rho choices, high-digit exchange and joining with its field orders, R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces with sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(e^tau), binary padding to [q^e], and the unequal-width case match lines 1649-1762.

It has the basic identities, P_M conjugation to coordinate kernels, the slot/column layout with one child per residual vector, inverse children via (C^-1)^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, all as in the paper.

It follows the paper in full: the eight conditional updates and their cycles, the guard segments, the cyclic shifts, the bad set with guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11] and delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, the repair of the permutation T_0 S_0^{-1} on B by radix sort, the cost terms with their family simplification, and the application to a change of basis at O(V((eK)^tau+1)). The headline O(V(L^tau+1)) holds only in the parameter family, which S4.6.2.12 states.

It has individual kernels at O(Ve), q_0 and k_0, row divisibility, V/W role streams, the exponent conditions, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). S4.6.3.2's wording seems to fold the children into the node overhead; S4.6.3.7 gives it correctly.

The guard-width constants (E, B, nu=11, C_1=20, C_0=128mB^2), A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the depth-to-size conversion, Delta=o(p), the uniformity of the packed-call cost terms, and the single-truncation error below sqrt2 2^-p all match the paper.

It covers character cancellation, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage, B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the grouped rounds with J_E, the layout L (prefix slots, at most Dq-1 width-K exchanges), the per-round layer cost, the monomial implementation, one truncation per round, error sqrt2 l 2^-p, and the operators L B F^- and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1}. The S5.2 method misdescribes the round order (see errors).

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, the two's-complement packing carries, centered-residue extraction with its residual identity, the negacyclic reduction, the truncation shift by p+l, and the four products dominating all match.

Retained LB order with P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the normalization M F^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r)=(f*g)/(rM), the error chain 2delta+eta and then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and the cost including O(Tp log(rp)) all match.

Gaussian maps S and T, the identity T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, N=CTD with Neumann inversion, the normalized contractions and the 2^{-2alpha^2} product, ordered numerical maps and selection C, then tensoring, linewise errors dp^2, cost, and axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) all follow the proofs.

Periodicity of a, the coefficient comparison giving exp(2 pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i), Q reading frequency -s_i j_i, F^+ R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ with t_i units mod s_i, and the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2 all match.

The sizes, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime intervals, S/T>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} prime search are derived as in the paper. The check that the fixed exponents satisfy the layer conditions (tau(1+c/beta)<lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)=1-2^-51<lambda') at 4018-4036, and the comparison constants a_d, a_r, b_d, b_r, C_l at 4073-4088, are not shown.

Phi as an algebra isomorphism via the order of the image of x, the triangular coordinate formula, padding, updates in the order i=d..1, rotation of the valid interval, and the axis-reversal cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) match.

Well-definedness via (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal invertible isometry, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, the identity M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed twist sequence with factor errors below 2*2^-p all match.

The chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A=RF_s, the opposite version by conjugation, digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, and the six steps with the two scales S and 2^{2b+4}S match. S8's headline cost phrase is wrong (see errors), but the item's content is correct.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, the complex convolution <6TL, the chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the pointwise and opposite steps, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, and the carry recurrence with its invariant all follow the paper.

It has the seven table rows with their powers of p, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^-181=2kappa, the row justifications, the o(V) setup and exceptional-stream bounds, absorption of powers of log p by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff.

S1 names the Schonhage-Strassen n log n conjecture and the strict power saving. No step states what an eventual lower bound requires (T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n for all large n), or that liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it.

errors.says: The algorithm obtains the exact 2n-bit product 'in O(Tp) steps beyond the layer costs'.
errors.paper: Several non-layer stages cost more than O(Tp). The Gaussian line maps cost O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha), CRT and axis layouts O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)), chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), chirps O(Tdp^{1+delta}) and packed products O(Tp log(rp)) (cost table and its justification). S9 later states these correctly.

errors.says: At a node with e=m^k chunks, 'the s children plus binary basis changes, scalar gates, endpoint corrections and reassembly cost O(V((eK)^tau+1)) at that node'.
errors.paper: Only the node overhead excluding the s recursive calls costs O(V((eK)^tau+1)). The children are charged separately as s(V/W)F(e/m), giving the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1). S4.6.3.7 states this correctly.

errors.says: Method: 'run the first b+1<=K rounds on prefix slots bit by bit, run the remaining qK rounds with the fast simultaneous layer'.
errors.paper: The prefix-slot rounds are not all first. The top round h=l-1 on long axes comes first, then the qK rounds h=l-2..b on the chunks, and finally the bottom positions h=b-1..0.

errors.says: The total dimension L lost on decreasing edges 'is L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, below N/2'.
errors.paper: The ratios L/N are 100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, i.e. L<N/2. The step compares a ratio with N/2. S4.3.5 states it correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. S4 builds the fixed exchange network, its frames, labels and rank budget. From these it gets the exponent tau=sigma=1-2^-50 and both fast tape procedures, each derived through its recurrence. S5 to S9 then reduce multiplication to convolution, the ring transforms and resampling with the permutations left in the formulas, assemble the algorithm, prove exact recovery, and total the cost with margin 2kappa. It thins in three places: the consistency check of the fixed exponents against the layer conditions (lines 4018-4036) is missing, S8's headline cost claim is inaccurate (S9 repairs it), and the conjecture-negation logic is only alluded to.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(h,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, banks indexed by a in T^3, and a fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and each edge pays only D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decrease on central wires 3->4 losing h are all stated, with the side-edge nesting check.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
The sum of |Delta dim| is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b once the N source ranks are added.

L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, with the remark that the interface adds only N source ranks so a strict saving remains, giving s<Wm. The complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0 is explicit, and the bit deficit is implicit in s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, checked for X_a as P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}, so the network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) through the geometric-sum cases.

central.summary: The plan rebuilds the whole chain of the central saving, with each step's defining quantities in place. It starts from the fixed h=100 exchange network and frames, then the nested labels with their single loss of h on central edges and rank equal to dimension change (N exceptional source edges), giving the budget Wm-N+2L with L/N<1/2. The endpoint identity and rank-a shears as a recursive calls then produce F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^{1-2^-50}.
